THE ASSIGNMENT
ContextContributionRelated expertise

ADB TA-6950-BAN: Supporting Education Sector Projects (56088-001)

The question
behind the work.

Contributed economic and financial feasibility analysis in the education sector in Bangladesh, assessing the viability of the proposed New Secondary and Madrasah Education Projects. Objectives included reviewing government policies, assessing consultation proceedings, examining existing EdTech interventions, market and demand analysis, technical feasibility assessment, environmental and disaster risk analysis, financial cost-benefit analysis, and institutional, legal and capacity assessment.

Analytical contribution.

  1. 01

    Performed in-depth market analysis, SWOT assessments, and economic and financial cost-benefit analyses — estimating economic and financial net present value, cost-benefit ratio, and internal rate of return.

  2. 02

    Conducted risk (uncertainty) and sensitivity analysis by varying key assumptions across scenarios.

  3. 03

    Prepared cost estimates reviewing proposed interventions, output plan, and implementation timeline.

  4. 04

    Prepared the full analysis in Excel and narratives as part of feasibility study reports in accordance with Planning Commission requirements.

  5. 05

    Provided inputs for technical/technological and engineering analysis including alternative/options analysis, and human resources and administrative support analysis.
